## Tutorials

The Chr() function returns the character for the specified ASCII number code.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Chr(65) AS CodeToCharacter;

---

Chr(
code
)
```

## Tutorials

The & operator allows you to add two or more strings together.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Address & ", " & PostalCode & ", " & City AS Address
FROM Customers;

---

string1
&
string2
&
string_n
```

## Tutorials

The CurDir() function returns the full path for a 
specified drive.

### Code Examples

```
CurDir()
CurDir("D")

---

C:\Documents and Settings\user\My Documents
D:\

---

CurDir(
drive
)
```

## Tutorials

The Format() function formats a value with the specified format.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Format(Price, "Currency") AS FormattedPrice
FROM Products;

---

Format(
value
,
format
)
```

## Tutorials

The InStr() function gets the position of the first occurrence of a string in another.

This function performs a case-insensitive search.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT InStr("Customer", "t") AS MatchPosition;

---

,

,
```
